name: Valstag Ironjaw
summary: At Menethil Keep, Valstag Ironjaw helps guard the road between Loch Modan and the coast. He warns the garrison of dangers to travelers and supplies.

sections.title: Duty at the Keep
sections.body: Valstag Ironjaw serves with the dwarven garrison inside Menethil Keep in Menethil Harbor. Dragonmaw orcs and ravenous wildlife threaten their communications and supplies. So he helps coordinate defenses on the main roads, especially the perilous way through Dun Algaz toward Loch Modan.

sections.title: Securing the Pass
sections.body: Hostile forces crowd the Algaz Gauntlet, putting travelers and supply convoys between Menethil Harbor and Loch Modan at risk. Valstag sends capable adventurers against the brigands and orcs in the passes. He also carries military reports between forward scouts and commanders such as Captain Stoutfist.

faq.q: Where can I find Valstag Ironjaw?
faq.answer: You can find Valstag Ironjaw inside Menethil Keep, the stone fortress in Menethil Harbor in the western Wetlands.

faq.q: What role does Valstag play in the Wetlands?
faq.answer: Valstag Ironjaw is an Ironforge dwarf at the keep. He helps defend the mountain roads leading back to the dwarven heartlands.

faq.q: Why is the pass to Loch Modan such a concern for him?
faq.answer: The Algaz Gauntlet links Menethil Harbor's coastal port to Loch Modan and Ironforge. Hostile forces there threaten food, troop movements and supplies.
Captain Stoutfist is a senior officer in Menethil Keep. Valstag coordinates with him so military reports and security dispatches reach the garrison command.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you rely on the route Valstag helps keep open between Menethil Harbor and the mountains of Khaz Modan, for trade and travel.
As a dwarf traveling from Ironforge or Loch Modan, you find Valstag with the forward garrison guarding the western shoreline.
